Subject: Intro: Redwood Inference — missed you

Hi Alexa —

Sorry I missed you for our 2:00pm intro today. I know calendars get messy — wanted to quickly surface two open slots I have tomorrow so we can get a short 30-minute walkthrough on your timeline:

- Friday 5/5, 10:30–11:00am PDT
- Friday 5/5, 3:00–3:30pm PDT

If either works you can click here to pick and it will auto-add to both calendars: https://cal.redwood.com/d/dylan/30?slot=1

If neither fits, reply with a couple times that work and I’ll bend. I can cover a quick product demo and surface best practices for latency/cost controls for inference — Ben (cc'ed) will join for any technical questions.

Also attaching a 1-page summary of our pricing/hosting options so you have context before the call.

Thanks — hope we can connect soon.

Dylan Brooks
